new_scholarship.name: Bando di concorso per l'attribuzione di borse di studio, altri contributi economici e servizi, per il diritto allo studio universitario, per l'A.A. 2026/2027 (ERSU di Messina)
new_scholarship.funding_type: Need-based scholarship (borsa di studio) with free canteen service and, subject to availability, free accommodation, plus exemption from the regional right-to-study fee
new_scholarship.program_type: Regional right-to-study scholarship (concorso) awarded by the regional agency, applied for separately from university admission
new_scholarship.official_source: E.R.S.U. di Messina - Ente Regionale per il diritto allo Studio Universitario
new_scholarship.duration: Benefits are granted for the legal duration of the degree course plus one extra-year: seven semesters for a laurea triennale, five semesters for a laurea magistrale biennale, nine semesters for a laurea magistrale a ciclo unico of four years, eleven for five years and thirteen for six. For the first out-of-course semester the scholarship is paid at half the standard amount. The canteen and accommodation services run for the academic year. The scholarship is re-competed each academic year.
new_scholarship.deadline: 18 August 2026 at 14.00 (Italian time) for students enrolled, or enrolling, on laurea triennale, laurea magistrale and laurea magistrale a ciclo unico courses; OTP validation of the application by 18 August 2026 at 15.00 for international students and minors. A later window ran from 25 September 2026 to 13.00 on 16 November 2026 for doctoral and specialisation students. The window opened at 12.00 on 1 July 2026.
new_scholarship.application_period: Annual competitive call for A.A. 2026/2027, published on 1 July 2026: applications from 1 July 2026 to 14.00 on 18 August 2026 for first-cycle (laurea triennale) and second-cycle degree students; from 25 September 2026 to 13.00 on 16 November 2026 for doctoral and specialisation students. The previous cycle closed on 18 August 2025.
new_scholarship.application_method: Separate application, not automatic on university admission. The applicant submits the online application on the ERSU di Messina student portal and validates it with the OTP sent to the e-mail and telephone number given; the application is paid for by no fee. The University of Messina is one of the institutions whose students may compete for this regional scholarship, but the University does not award it.
new_scholarship.description: The borsa di studio of the Ente Regionale per il diritto allo Studio Universitario (E.R.S.U.) di Messina is the principal need-based funding instrument for students enrolled at Sicilian universities, including the University of Messina. It is awarded through an annual regional competition to students enrolled, or enrolling, on their first degree. Winners receive a monetary quota whose value is set by the ISEE band and by whether the student is in sede, pendolare or fuori sede or independent; the quota is Euro 7,171.11 per year for fuori sede or independent students in the standard ISEE band, Euro 4,190.71 for pendolari and Euro 2,890.16 for studenti in sede, raised by 15 per cent where ISEE is below half the maximum reference limit. Winners also receive free access to the Agency's canteen services and, subject to availability and on request, free accommodation, and are exempted from the regional right-to-study fee. Non-EU students may be admitted conditionally while documents are outstanding and can regularise their position by the dates the call sets.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Students enrolled, or enrolling, on their first degree at the University of Messina or another Sicilian university whose families meet the ISEE and ISPE economic thresholds of the call, particularly fuori sede students who need an accommodation place and free canteen meals, and students from low-income countries who can evidence their economic condition through the routes the call provides for them.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to students of any nationality, including students without Italian citizenship. Eligibility requires enrolment, or planned enrolment, for the achievement of a FIRST degree on a degree course at the University of Messina or another Sicilian institution; an economic condition with ISEE not exceeding Euro 22,500.00 and ISPE not exceeding Euro 53,000.00 for A.A. 2026/2027; and the academic merit set by the call. Students are excluded if they already hold a title of the same or a higher level, or if they have already received the scholarship in a previous programme at the same level and have not repaid it.
eligibility: Regular enrolment, or intent to enrol, for the achievement of the FIRST degree on a laurea course at the University of Messina or another Sicilian institution
Economic condition for A.A. 2026/2027: ISEE not exceeding Euro 22,500.00 and ISPE not exceeding Euro 53,000.00
Academic merit requirements set by art. 5.3 of the call, verified by the Agency through official acquisition of the valid credits registered for the course the student is enrolled on
Not already in possession of an academic title of the same level
Not having already received the scholarship in a previous programme of the same level without having repaid it
Free of charge: no application fee
coverage: Monetary quota, whose value is set by the ISEE band and by student status: Euro 8,246.77 (fuori sede or independent), Euro 4,819.32 (pendolare) or Euro 3,323.68 (in sede) where ISEE is below half the maximum reference limit; Euro 7,171.11, Euro 4,190.71 and Euro 2,890.16 respectively in the standard band; progressively reduced to half, with minima of Euro 3,585.55, Euro 2,095.35 and Euro 1,445.08, above two-thirds of the reference limit
Free access to the ERSU canteen service for winners
Free accommodation in an ERSU residence for winners, subject to availability of the Agency and, for the relevant categories, on request
Exemption from the regional tax for the right to university study (tassa regionale)
Partial coverage of the cost of living; tuition, travel and other living costs are not covered
benefits: Monetary quota paid in instalments by bank transfer to a current account or prepaid card with an Italian or SEPA IBAN in the beneficiary student's own name
Free accommodation (posto letto) in an ERSU residence for winners, subject to availability
Exemption from the regional fee for the right to university study

Increase of 15% where ISEE is below half the maximum reference limit; a further 40% where the student has a disability under article 3 of Law 104/1992 or an invalidity of 66% or more; a further 20% for students enrolled in STEM courses; a further 20% for students simultaneously enrolled on two degree programmes
Students enrolled at the Noto and Priolo teaching poles, who cannot use the canteen, receive an increase of the scholarship of Euro 600,00 if in sede or pendolari and Euro 1.200,00 if fuori sede
Half scholarship for the first out-of-course semester; benefits end on graduation
requirements: Submit the online application on the ERSU di Messina student portal within the call window
Hold an ISEE, or for international students an ISEE parificato ISEEU/ISPEU, relating to the applicant student, within the limits set for A.A. 2026/2027
Be enrolled, or enrol, for the first degree on a degree course at a Sicilian institution
Meet the merit requirements of art. 5.3 of the call, verified by the Agency through official acquisition of valid credits
Declare an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN in the student's own name for payment of the quota
International students upload the ISEEU and ISPEU parificato in the Fascicolo section of the student portal by 16 September 2026
Non-EU students regularise their position by 16 September 2026, or by 30 November 2026 for those conditionally admitted, and are placed at the bottom of the ranking
required_documents: Online application on the ERSU di Messina student portal, validated by OTP
ISEE, or ISEEU/ISPEU parificato for international students, relating to the applicant student
Italian or SEPA-area IBAN of a current account or prepaid card in the student's own name

For international students from poor countries: a valid residence permit or the receipt for its issue or renewal, with a certification from the Italian Representation in the country of origin attesting that the student does not belong to a family known for high income and elevated social status
Documents issued by foreign authorities, where the call requires them, translated into Italian and legalised where required
new_scholarship.selection_notes: A single competitive regional ranking is drawn up. Candidates are ranked principally on economic condition expressed through ISEE and ISPE, within the bands the call sets; the monetary value of the quota then follows the ISEE band and student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede or independent), with the published increments. Academic merit requirements (art. 5.3) are verified by the Agency through official acquisition of the valid credits registered for the course the student is enrolled on in the year, rather than by a self-declared transcript. No published weighting between economic and merit factors exists.

new_scholarship.notes:
SUBSTITUTION, recorded as the contract requires. The slot-05 assignment target was the University of
Padova international undergraduate scholarships, named in the task as the 'Padua International
Excellence Scholarship' and the related tuition-waiver awards on unipd.it. That target is a
duplicate: backend/config/programme_details.json already carries the award under LIVE ids 136 and
370, host www.unipd.it, registrable domain unipd.it, and the assignment table was filtered against
precisely that collision. RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md section 5 requires substituting one alternative
bachelor's-level scholarship in the same host region and keeping the same output filename, which
this record does. The substitute is the ERSU di Messina borsa di studi: it is in the same host
region (Italy, Europe), it funds first-cycle degree programmes, and it carries the
international-student provisions the original target's subject required (a route for students from
poor countries, and conditional admission for non-EU students with a regularisation deadline).
The substituted award's name is corrected to the scheme's real published name; the assigned
target's name is not preserved as the award title.

SCHEMA CORRECTION. The previous slot-05 artifact on disk was a top-level JSON ARRAY holding one
79-key record in the flat shape that SCHEMA_CONTRACT.md itself calls v1 and 'wrong'. The v2
contract, AGENT_TASK_CONTRACT.md and validate_bachelor.js all require exactly six top-level keys
and discover records by the presence of a new_scholarship block. As written, the array had no
new_scholarship key, so the validator skipped the file entirely and slot 05 counted as missing
while still being marked complete. This file is written in the required six-key shape.

AWARDING BODY VERSUS ELIGIBLE INSTITUTION. The University of Messina, named in this record only
as one of the institutions whose students may compete, does not award this scholarship. The
awarding body is the E.R.S.U. di Messina, a regional agency established by Law No. 20 of 2002.
The logo is the Agency's own mark served from the Agency's own domain, not a university mark.

The exemption the call grants is limited to the regional fee for the right to university study (tassa regionale), which is a regional levy and not the University of Messina tuition or registration fees. The University of Messina's broader phrasing was not used to widen this, and no official page read states that university tuition is waived.

Tuition, travel and living costs beyond the quota are not covered, so the award is need-based support rather than a full scholarship.

programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: No nationality restriction and no residency requirement is set by the call. Eligibility is fixed by economic condition (ISEE and ISPE), by enrolment for a first degree at a Sicilian institution, and by the merit requirements of the call. The call is published in Italian and the Agency's own portal carries the application in Italian, but the eligibility rules contain no citizenship test.
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Open to students of any nationality, including students without Italian citizenship, subject to the same ISEE and ISPE and merit requirements. International students who do not have an Italian ISEE must obtain an ISEEU and ISPEU parificato, relating to the family nucleus, from a CAF associated with the Agency, and upload it in the Fascicolo section of the portal by 16 September 2026. International students obtained abroad are given international protection or recognised as stateless must use the same parificato route. Students from poor countries defined by Ministerial Decree No. 176 of 24 February 2026 may instead provide a valid residence permit, or the receipt for its issue or renewal, together with a certification issued by the Italian Representation in the country of origin attesting that the student does not belong to a family known for high income and elevated social status. Non-EU students may be admitted conditionally (ammessi con riserva) while documents are outstanding and regularise their position by 16 September 2026, or by 30 November 2026 for the conditionally admitted, being placed at the bottom of the ranking. One practical constraint is economic rather than legal: a family whose income is produced in a low-income country may be unable to produce documentation at the thresholds.
programme_detail_official.study_mode: Not specified on the pages read. The call applies to students enrolled on the degree courses named in it and does not distinguish full-time from part-time enrolment, so no study-mode condition is recorded.
programme_detail_official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No subject restriction. The concorso is open across the degree courses of the Sicilian institutions covered, so all fields are eligible. Two provisions are field-linked in effect rather than by subject: the 20% increase for students enrolled in STEM courses, and the Euro 600,00 or Euro 1.200,00 increase for students at the Noto and Priolo teaching poles who cannot use the canteen.
programme_detail_official.application_method: Separate, competitive application. The applicant submits the online application on the ERSU di Messina student portal and validates it with the OTP sent to the e-mail address and telephone number given in the application. There is no automatic consideration on admission to the University of Messina. The application is free of charge.
programme_detail_official.application_route: Submit the online application on the ERSU di Messina student portal within the window set by the call, and validate it with the OTP sent by e-mail and text message. The call documents, identified as the published bando, are downloaded from the Agency, which publishes the current call and its results. The exact portal URL was not confirmed during this research session and is recorded as null rather than guessed; an institution check is required before applicants are directed to it.

programme_detail_official.description: The borsa di studio is awarded by the E.R.S.U. di Messina, the regional agency that manages the right to university study in Sicily under articles 3 and 34 of the Italian Constitution, and is the principal need-based funding instrument for students enrolled at the University of Messina and the other Sicilian institutions. It is awarded through an annual regional competition and applied for separately from university admission, through the Agency's own student portal. Winners receive a monetary quota fixed by the ISEE band and by student status, plus free access to the Agency's canteen service and, subject to availability and on request, free accommodation, and are exempted from the regional fee for the right to university study. For A.A. 2026/2027 the quota is Euro 2,890.16 per year for studenti in sede, Euro 4,190.71 for pendolari and Euro 7,171.11 for fuori sede or independent students in the standard band, with the minima, maxima and the disability, STEM and Noto and Priolo increases the call sets. Non-EU students may be admitted conditionally while documents are outstanding and regularise their position by the dates the call provides.
programme_detail_official.program_type: Regional right-to-study need-based scholarship awarded by a regional agency, applied for separately from university admission
programme_detail_official.coverage: A cash quota of Euro 2,890.16 to Euro 8,246.77 per year depending on ISEE band and student status, free canteen service, free accommodation for winners subject to availability, and exemption from the regional right-to-study fee. Not covered: university tuition and registration fees, travel, and living costs beyond the quota. No travel allowance or installation allowance is published.

application_readiness_checklist: Understand who awards this before you plan around it: the University of Messina does not award the borsa di studio. The awarding body is the E.R.S.U. di Messina, a regional agency, and you compete in its own regional competition.

Confirm you are applying for your FIRST degree. The call excludes anyone who already holds a title of the same level, and includes anyone who already received the scholarship in a previous same-level programme and has not repaid it.
Start the ISEE early. For A.A. 2026/2027 the economic limits are ISEE not exceeding Euro 22,500.00 and ISPE not exceeding Euro 53,000.00, and an invalid or late ISEE ends the application.

If you are an international student without an Italian ISEE, request the ISEEU and ISPEU parificato from a CAF associated with the Agency, and upload it in the Fascicolo section of the portal by 16 September 2026.
Confirm you are fuori sede, pendolare or in sede, since the base quota is Euro 7,171.11, Euro 4,190.71 or Euro 2,890.16 respectively for the standard band.
Prepare an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN for an account or prepaid card in your own name, since the quota is paid in instalments by bank transfer.
Submit the online application on the Agency portal and complete OTP validation within the window, treating the stated hour (14.00 on 18 August 2026) as a hard boundary, not the end of the day.

If you are a non-EU student, know that you can be admitted conditionally and regularise by 16 September 2026, or by 30 November 2026 if conditionally admitted, but that you will be placed at the bottom of the ranking.

If you are from a poor country defined by Ministerial Decree No. 176 of 24 February 2026, prepare a valid residence permit or the receipt for its issue or renewal, plus a certification from the Italian Representation in your country of origin attesting that you do not belong to a family known for high income and elevated social status.
Ask for the accommodation place at the time of application if you need one: the free bed place for winners is subject to availability of the Agency.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 14.00 closing time on 18 August 2026 by treating it as an end-of-day deadline. The call states the hour, and international students and minors have an even earlier OTP deadline of 15.00.
Assuming the University of Messina will consider you automatically. This is a separate Agency competition, and there is no automatic consideration on admission.
Already holding a title of the same or a higher level, which forfeits eligibility outright.
An ISEE above Euro 22,500.00, or an ISPE above Euro 53,000.00, for A.A. 2026/2027.
An international student holding no ISEE and missing the 16 September 2026 ISEEU and ISPEU upload deadline.
A non-EU student who does not regularise by 16 September 2026, or by 30 November 2026 if conditionally admitted, and is therefore placed at the bottom of the ranking.

Failing the merit requirements of art. 5.3, which the Agency verifies by official acquisition of the valid credits registered for the course the student is enrolled on, so a transcript you submit does not substitute.
Using a family income produced in the country of origin without obtaining the parificato, which is the most common practical barrier for students from low-income countries.
Forgetting the IBAN: the quota cannot be paid without an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN in the beneficiary's own name.
Applying in the wrong window: doctoral and specialisation students had a different closing time, 13.00 on 16 November 2026.
Assuming the free accommodation is guaranteed. It is subject to availability, and conditionally on request for the relevant categories.
Assuming the exemption covers university tuition. It covers the regional right-to-study fee only.
estimated_uncovered_costs: University of Messina tuition and registration fees. The scholarship is not a tuition waiver: the call scopes its exemption to the regional fee, so budget the full fee unless you separately qualify for an ISEE-based exemption.

Living costs in Messina beyond the quota. The quota is fixed by your ISEE band and status, and its minimum for the fuori sede category is Euro 3,585.55, so read the value for your own band before budgeting.
Travel to Italy and back, for which the award publishes no allowance.
The cost of living in the first weeks before the quota instalments arrive.
Accommodation for eligible non-winners, who are not entitled to the free place and must find and pay for a private arrangement.
The cost of obtaining the ISEE, or the ISEEU and ISPEU parificato, and of the notarised or translated documents an international student may need.
Any fee for the payment notices the Agency sends, which the call states are a charge on the student.
document_audit: The application itself is online on the Agency portal and is validated by OTP; it is not a paper or e-mail application.
The economic evidence is the ISEE, or the ISEEU and ISPEU parificato for international students, relating to the applicant student.
The IBAN is declared in the application and must belong to the beneficiary student.

Merit is verified by the Agency through official acquisition of the valid credits registered for the course the student is enrolled on, so no transcript is requested from the applicant for that purpose.

Students from poor countries defined by Ministerial Decree No. 176 of 24 February 2026 provide a residence permit, or the receipt for its issue or renewal, plus a certification from the Italian Representation in the country of origin instead of a parificato.
Documents issued by foreign authorities must be translated into Italian and legalised where required.

alerts.message: Benefits run for the legal duration plus one extra year, are halved in the first out-of-course semester, and end when you graduate. Holding the scholarship in a previous same-level programme without repaying it excludes you from this one.

submission_workflow: Read the published call on the Agency's own document, which sets the ISEE and ISPE limits, the merit requirements, the quota bands and the results and instalment schedule.
Obtain an ISEE, or an ISEEU and ISPEU parificato from a CAF associated with the Agency, before submitting.
Confirm your student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede or independent), since it fixes the base quota.
Prepare an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN in your own name.
Enrol, or plan to enrol, for your first degree at the University of Messina or another Sicilian institution.
Submit the online application on the Agency portal during the window, requesting the accommodation place if you need one.
Complete OTP validation with the code sent to your e-mail and telephone number, within the earlier deadline that applies to international students and minors.
Watch the results and instalment schedule the call sets, and regularise as a non-EU student by 16 September 2026, or by 30 November 2026 if you were admitted conditionally.
Meet the merit requirements of art. 5.3 to retain the second instalment of the quota.
Plan for the next cycle: applications are expected to open in the first half of July 2027.

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed:
Confirmed from the awarding body's own call, which funds first-cycle degree programmes.
The call is the bando for the attribution of scholarships, other economic contributions and services
for the right to university study for A.A. 2026/2027, and lists among the courses its merit
requirements cover the Laurea triennale e magistrale a ciclo unico, with the first-year credit
requirements of 20 credits by 10 August 2027 and 15 credits by 30 November 2027. Its duration
provision sets the benefit at seven semesters for a laurea triennale, five semesters for a laurea
magistrale biennale and nine, eleven or thirteen semesters for a laurea magistrale a ciclo unico of
four, five or six years. Because the call covers first-cycle, second-cycle, doctoral and
specialisation courses, the award funds a bachelor's degree alongside the higher levels, and
degree_levels is recorded as "Bachelor's" with the higher levels recorded in
programme_detail_official.degree_levels, as the contract requires for an award covering both
cycles.
research_notes.schema_correction:
The previous slot-05 artifact on disk was a top-level JSON array containing one record with
seventy-nine flat top-level keys. SCHEMA_CONTRACT.md names that shape as v1 and states it was
wrong; the v2 contract, AGENT_TASK_CONTRACT.md and validate_bachelor.js all require exactly six
top-level keys, and the validator discovers a record only when it carries a new_scholarship block.
Because the array had no such block, the file was skipped by discovery and slot 05 was counted as
missing while the file still sat on disk. This record is written in the required six-key shape and
is therefore discoverable and mergeable.
